review_scope: Every selected Mech AOT and JIT profile in programs, including compact/secondary variants; not only fastest endpoints. Interpreted profiles are counted for scope but their correction is a separate review.
included: Child process launch and startup through normal exit and parent wait completion.
Runtime initialization, workload input reading, computation and complete output written to regular-file sinks.
JIT source loading, parsing, admission and per-invocation native compilation.
Child output flushing and teardown before exit; this is not a durable disk fsync measurement.
excluded: Offline AOT compilation/linking, as for other precompiled executables.
Harness prechecks, input-file preopening and temporary output-file creation.
Post-exit output hashing, correctness validation and report bookkeeping.
Untimed validation/warmup invocations are separate fresh processes; fresh process does not imply cold OS caches.
evidence_limits: This review compares retained JSON samples and medians and reads retained producer/runner source. It performs no new benchmark, compiler, binary inspection or runtime rehash.
Recorded source/report/executable identities are historical catalog evidence, not newly verified file hashes in this review.
Retained producer source corroborates the raw protocol and sample schemas; this review does not independently establish an execution-time source hash for every historical helper.
Some historical reports retain command templates rather than expanded argv; two selected AOT profiles explicitly lack historical timed-argument receipts. These limitations remain listed per profile.
A launch-to-exit timing boundary does not independently prove required-work or source-count fidelity; those qualifications belong to their existing evidence.

The current same-workload ratio denominator is Mech AOT. The interpreted preparation exclusion does not change AOT or JIT samples, but its own ranking must use a clearly different label or whole-process values.

aot-application.historical_limit: The retained report records binary hashes and samples but not each expanded timed argv. The retained producer constructs the timed command from the selected binary and baseline arguments; the catalog build command is not a timed-command receipt.

aot-mandelbrot.registration: The native process registration pipe write occurs inside the measured region.

jit.selection_rule: seconds is wall for JIT; only resident mode selects kernel_seconds.
